segments.text: Researchers combined 691 findings on why people put things off.
Four predictors stood out: unpleasant tasks, far-off rewards, low confidence, and impulsiveness.
Saying "I'll start tomorrow" pushes any reward even further away.
That's linked with delay across studies, not a verdict on you.
The review didn't test fixes, so the next step is our suggestion.
Make the start tiny, so the task feels less unpleasant and more doable.
Try it today: do the first 2 minutes only.
